        public void solve(int testNumber, FastScanner in, FastPrinter out) {
            final int SHIFT = 15;
            final int MAXN = 60;

            int[][][] dp = new int[MAXN + 1][MAXN + 1][2 * SHIFT + 1];
            for (int[][] layer : dp) {
                for (int[] row : layer) {
                    Arrays.fill(row, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                }
            }
            dp[MAXN][[MAXN][SHIFT] = 0;

            char[] digits = ("000" + in.next()).toCharArray();

            for (int pos = digits.length - 1; pos >= 0; pos--) {
                int digit = digits[pos] - '0';

                int[][][] temp = new int[MAXN + 1][MAXN + 1][2 * SHIFT + 1];
                for (int[][] layer : temp) {
                    for (int[] row : layer) {
                        Arrays.fill(row, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    }
                }

                for (int plus = MAXN; plus >= 0; plus--) {
                    for (int minus = MAXN; minus >= 0; minus--) {
                        for (int carry = 0; carry <= 2 * SHIFT; carry++) {
                            int curVal = dp[plus][minus][carry];
                            if (curVal == Integer.MAX_VALUE) continue;

                            int realCarry = carry - SHIFT;
                            int curN = plus - minus + realCarry;
                            int curD = (curN % 10 + 10) % 10;
                            int newCarry = (curN - curD) / 10;

                            if (curD == digit) {
                                int cost = plus + minus + curVal;
                                if (cost < temp[plus][minus][newCarry + SHIFT]) {
                                    temp[plus][minus][newCarry + SHIFT] = cost;
                                }
                            }

                            if (plus + 1 <= MAXN) {
                                if (dp[plus + 1][minus][carry] < temp[plus][minus][carry]) {
                                    temp[plus][minus][carry] = dp[plus + 1][minus][carry];
                                }
                            }
                            if (minus + 1 <= MAXN) {
                                if (dp[plus][minus + 1][carry] < temp[plus][minus][carry]) {
                                    temp[plus][minus][carry] = dp[plus][minus + 1][carry];
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                dp = temp;
            }

            int answer = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int i = 0; i <= MAXN; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= MAXN; j++) {
                    answer = Math.min(answer, dp[i][j][SHIFT]);
                }
            }
            out.println(answer);
        }
    }

    static class FastScanner extends BufferedReader {
        public FastScanner(InputStream is) {
            super(new InputStreamReader(is));
        }

        public String next() {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            int c;

        private int readChar() {
